title: Mall World Dreamers: What do our personalities have in common?
content: Hey everyone! When I came across this channel I was very fascinated in The Mall World. I know people dream of similar scenarios like losing teeth or being late to work, but this doesn't feel like just the brain coming up with similar scenarios because of the fact that we have free will and the urge to explore a place with insanely similar and detailed visuals to others. I'm curious if there's a connection or a pattern to maybe why certain people have these similar experiences. Feel free to answer the questions you're comfortable with and let's see if there's any patterns!! 1. Did you have strong dream recall and intense dreams before/after you started dreaming of Mall World? 2. Do you have a lot of internal monologue? 3. Do you/have you struggled with insomnia? 4. Did you start having dreams of the Mall World in a particularly impactful time of your life? If so, did the negative or positive real life experience correlate to your negative or positive experience in the mall world? 5. Have you done hallucinogenics? 6. Do you have a mental illness? If so, do you take any medications or sleep supplements? 7. Do you consider yourself a more artistic or logical person? 8. Have you experienced significant trauma before you started dreaming of the Mall World? 9. Have you tried to intentionally lucid dream before your Mall World dreams started? Lastly, what are your thoughts on possible explanations of the Mall World?
